title: Brand Colour Strategy
summary: Telefónica's brand colour strategy centres on a defined palette anchored by brand blue #0066FF, with navy reserved for dark bands and semantic colours used sparingly, applied consistently across all corporate communications.
position: The primary brand colour is blue #0066FF, which serves as the dominant colour across all corporate templates and communications [E2, E4]. Surfaces are restricted to white and one or two blues, while navy blue is reserved exclusively for dark bands [E2]. Intense blue is further specified for covers and band elements, with the five-pointed 'T' logotype rendered in white on a blue background [E3]. Semantic colours are permitted only in moderation and must remain coherent with the 2026 brand guidelines [E2]. Colour must never be used as the sole means of conveying information, and all colour applications must meet minimum contrast ratios to satisfy accessibility requirements [E1]. Global Brand Director Lucía Ferrer is responsible for validating coherence with global brand identity [E4].
